claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Cilnidipine is a dihydropyridine L-/N-type calcium channel blocker that is not expected to kill cancer cells at 2.5 uM; any antiproliferative effect would likely reflect weak, non-selective calcium channel blockade or physicochemical effects rather than a potent cytotoxic mechanism.
